Petitioners file this petition for quashing of the FIR No.190/2020 under Section 406/498A/34 Indian Penal Code registered at police station Nihal Vihar, Delhi against them and the proceedings emanating therefrom.
2. The marriage between the petitioner No.1 and complainant/ respondent No.2 was solemnized on 28.08.2011 according to Sikh rites and ceremonies at Delhi.
From this wedlock one male child was born on 27.11.2011.
However, due to matrimonial discord, the couple could not live together and on the complaint of respondent No.2 aforesaid FIR was registered against the petitioners.
During the pendency of proceedings, the couple has settled the matter per settlement agreement dated 22.04.2022 before the Counselling Cell, Tis Hazari Courts, Delhi.

entities.text: Counselling Cell, Tis Hazari Courts, Delhi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: It was also transpired the respondent No.2 along with minor son has joined the matrimonial home with petitioner No.1 since 08.02.2022 and are living happily.
It is submitted petitioner No.1 taking care of all the needs of respondent No.2.
Pursuant to settlement, the respondent No.2 does not wish to take any action against any of the petitioners.
3. The complainant/respondent No.2 has been duly identified by the Investigating Officer, states the matter has been settled with the petitioners and she has no objection if the FIR is quashed.
The learned APP for the State has also no objection, if this petition is allowed.
The affidavits of parties are on record.

sentences.text: Considering the above settlement between the parties, there is no impediment in quashing of the FIR as complainant has settled all the disputes and has joined the matrimonial home with petitioner No.1.
In view of the above, there is no use to continue with the proceedings against petitioners as it would never entail in conviction of petitioners.
6. Accordingly, the petition is allowed.
Consequently, FIR No.190/2020 under Section 406/498A/34 Indian Penal Code registered at police station Nihal Vihar, Delhi and the proceedings emanating therefrom are quashed.
Pending application, if any, also stands disposed of.
No order as to costs.

YOGESH KHANNA, J.
